rules: not operationalisable: Instrument-selection procedure for quarterly index futures (ES/NQ): roll to whichever contract has the most open interest and volume on barchart.com, chart the back-adjusted continuous contract. It makes no claim about price behaviour, and the data it needs (per-contract open interest and volume across a futures curve) does not exist for the XAUUSD spot/OANDA M1 series, which has no contracts and no rolls.
